title: A sufficient home beyond final checks

captions.energy: Demanding final completion of every detail
captions.emotions: Feeling wholeness in available shared life

meaning: Your domestic support gains wholeness when meaningful choice recognises enough without making the experience of home depend on endless checks of completion.
text: You can create support thoughtfully: understanding a need, assessing options and using experience. The Hermit in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. The World in energy complicates them through demanding final completion. The World in emotions wants wholeness and sufficiency in the shared home. The repeated card distinguishes compulsory perfection of arrangements from feeling ready to live. The latter does not require every detail to stop changing. Home can already support both while staying open to small needs revealed only through actual use.

For example, you arrange a convenient home working corner but postpone the first peaceful evening until a perfectly suitable organiser is found. The space seems unready without it. **Wholeness need not be proved through the absence of one last detail.** You can use what was chosen while continuing the search separately. Experience emerges in living rather than merely comparing options, and a finished space keeps its value despite an object still existing mainly in your imagination.

The difficulty is noticing another missing detail after every completion. Requirements grow while sufficiency constantly lies ahead. A clear purpose offers more dependable support: is the arrangement convenient for both now? Thoughtfulness distinguishes a useful adjustment from another condition supposedly forbidding recognition of the result already achieved and peaceful use of your shared home.
